title: Epstein blackmail file on senior national security official
summary: Steven Greer tells of Epstein blackmail file on senior national security official, about 2000s-2025 at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: because there's a very senior person in the national security apparatus who is was part of that who's being kept on a short leash because they have a a blackmail file on it.

plain: Steven Greer, a long-time campaigner for UFO secrets to be made public, says on Jesse Michels's podcast that a very senior person in the US national security world was mixed up with Jeffrey Epstein, the wealthy financier, sometime between the 2000s and 2025. Greer says that because someone holds a blackmail file on this official, the official is kept "on a short leash." If true, it would mean that people guarding secrets inside government could be controlled from outside it.
